final_panel_description: Existing common independent panel; new initialization confirmation, not a newly unseen panel.
retry_policy: One identical registered-seed from-scratch rerun only after failed attempt ends; retain all failed artifacts, never select by score.
storage: Complete raw curves plus one fixed inference endpoint per training; no disk optimizer, replay or periodic checkpoints.
device_caveat: CPU/CUDA float64 numerical trajectories can differ; no mixed-device wall-clock algorithm ranking.
